Original detailed cinematic manga for ZERO-SUM: OMEN. Meticulous variable-weight black ink, selective crosshatching and controlled halftone, expressive anatomy and hands, clear perspective, tactile brass machinery and repaired clothing, matte gouache architectural depth, restrained colour accents. Serious action has weight and aftermath; comedy uses stillness and simplified expression. Teen-rated peril, no gore or sexualization. Preserve supplied character identity and asymmetric props. English left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Exact rectangular layout follows the coordinates below, with clean white gutters. Draw NO lettering, numerals, logos, sound effects, speech balloons, captions, HUD or readable signs. Leave quiet upper areas for separate lettering. Every required digit and word is a later vector layer. No imitation of a named artist or existing franchise. NIL uses they/them, RIGHT decoder, one orange hair streak, three abacus clasps, longer LEFT coat tail. Vesper has LEFT braid, two blank hat cards, seven-chamber gun. Varro is human under a repaired hound mask, with three jars. Never mirror these actors.
Colour script: warm window light and orange dawn through slate rain, open sky.
Panel p020_01 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.9, 0.35]: Quiet rooftop after rain, pair small left, distant Basilica. Folded map weighted by coin: six acquired-Seal sockets and one different resonance socket, all blank for later overlays.
Panel p020_02 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.42, 0.43, 0.24]: NIL counts seven sockets. Broken identity frame remains, resonance separate. Hand not over face.
Panel p020_03 at normalized rectangle [0.52, 0.42, 0.43, 0.24]: Look back toward warm window: Ama/Tobi safe together. Vesper coin remains pocketed.
Panel p020_04 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.68, 0.9, 0.27]: Broad final city and waterways. NIL first step BESIDE Vesper. Quiet lower strip for ending and next chapter, no full-campaign reveal.
Use an exact1000x1500 composition grid (scale proportionally to the output). Panel pixel boxes [x,y,w,h]: p020_01 [50, 75, 900, 525]; p020_02 [50, 630, 430, 360]; p020_03 [520, 630, 430, 360]; p020_04 [50, 1020, 900, 405]. Keep all art inside these boxes; gutters remain plain paper.
FINAL CONTINUITY: Draw ONLY this page's listed story cast: nil, vesper, ama, tobi. Ama: adult dark-brown-skinned mother, patched ochre wax-pattern dress, INDIGO headwrap, ash shawl and laundry basket. Tobi: nine-year-old dark-brown-skinned boy, short black curls, YELLOW oversized hoodie, patched blue jeans, bottlecap charms, no printed numbers. Do not add other named characters from style notes or other pages. The priest must NOT appear before the shrine entrance scene. Every mechanical readout is EMPTY SMOKED GLASS, never a portrait mirror; Civic/Audit/NaN lettering is added later. Preserve panel count, geometry and required geography. Clean 4K portrait page, no lettering, no balloons. Broad clean upper panel areas for separate text, faces/hands placed below those zones. Fine controlled ink detail at focal areas; strong black shapes and selective crosshatching; readable painted atmosphere, no glossy photorealism.
